lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, just upload it to the portal.
lines.zh: 可以，上傳到系統平台就好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, thank you.

scene_zh: 同學自願擔任今天的值日生
image_prompt_en: A chibi student holding a broom volunteering while classmates raise hands in a classroom

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Who's on class duty today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I can do it if no one else wants to.
lines.zh: 如果沒人要的話，我可以做。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's kind of you, thanks.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem, I don't mind at all.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我一點都不介意。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll help you clean up too.

scene_zh: 同學討論校外教學的集合時間與地點
image_prompt_en: Two chibi students looking at a bus schedule sheet near a school bus icon in a hallway

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What time do we need to meet tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We meet at the gate at eight.
lines.zh: 我們八點在校門口集合。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should we bring lunch?
lines.zh: 我們需要自己帶午餐嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, and don't forget water.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for the reminder.

scene_zh: 學生向老師詢問如何報名課後輔導
image_prompt_en: A chibi student talking to a teacher chibi holding a sign-up clipboard in an empty classroom after school

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How can I sign up for tutoring?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼報名課後輔導？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just write your name on this list.
lines.zh: 把你的名字寫在這張名單上就好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Which subject do you offer help with?
lines.zh: 你們提供哪些科目的輔導？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mostly math and English.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, I really need math help.
lines.zh: 太好了，我正好需要數學輔導。

scene_zh: 同學互相分享面對段考壓力的心情
image_prompt_en: Two chibi students sitting on a bench looking stressed with textbooks stacked beside them

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm so stressed about the exams.
lines.zh: 我對這次段考感到壓力好大。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Me too, there's so much to review.
lines.zh: 我也是，要複習的東西好多。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do you manage your stress?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I take short breaks between studying.
lines.zh: 我讀書中間會安排短暫休息。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's a good idea, I'll try it.
lines.zh: 這是個好方法，我來試試看。

title_en: Congratulating a Classmate on an Award
scene_zh: 同學恭喜朋友在比賽中獲獎
image_prompt_en: A chibi student handing a small trophy to a smiling classmate chibi in a school hallway

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Congratulations on winning the competition!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you, I couldn't believe it.
lines.zh: 謝謝，我自己都不敢相信。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You totally deserved it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I appreciate your support this whole time.
lines.zh: 謝謝你一直以來的支持。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's celebrate after school.
lines.zh: 放學後我們去慶祝一下吧。

scene_zh: 病人向醫生描述喉嚨痛的症狀
image_prompt_en: A chibi doctor in a white coat examines a chibi patient's throat with a tongue depressor in a bright clinic room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What seems to be the problem today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: My throat has been really sore since yesterday.
lines.zh: 我的喉嚨從昨天開始就很痛。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have a fever or a cough too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No fever, but it hurts when I swallow.
lines.zh: 沒有發燒，但吞東西的時候會痛。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let me take a quick look with this light.
lines.zh: 我用這個手電筒看一下喉嚨。

scene_zh: 打電話到診所預約門診時段
image_prompt_en: A chibi character on a phone call sits at a desk with a calendar, while a chibi receptionist at a clinic desk checks a schedule book.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to schedule an appointment with Dr. Lin.
lines.zh: 我想預約林醫師的門診。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, are you available this Thursday afternoon?
lines.zh: 好的，這週四下午方便嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That works. What time slots are open?
lines.zh: 可以，有哪些時段可以選？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We have a spot open at three thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, please book me in for that.
lines.zh: 太好了，幫我約那個時段。

scene_zh: 到藥局憑處方箋領取藥品
image_prompt_en: A chibi pharmacist behind a counter hands a white paper bag of medicine to a chibi customer holding a prescription slip.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm here to pick up a prescription for Chen.
lines.zh: 我來領陳先生的處方藥。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Give me one moment while I check the system.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure, take your time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Here you go, take one tablet twice a day.
lines.zh: 這是您的藥，一天吃兩次，一次一顆。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should I take it before or after meals?

scene_zh: 病人在牙醫診所進行例行洗牙
image_prompt_en: A chibi patient reclines in a dental chair with a bib on while a chibi dentist holds a small mirror and cleaning tool near the mouth.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you had any pain in your teeth lately?
lines.zh: 最近牙齒有沒有不舒服？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a little sensitivity when I eat cold food.
lines.zh: 吃冰的東西有一點敏感而已。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, let's start with a regular cleaning today.
lines.zh: 好，今天先幫你做一般的洗牙。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sounds good. Will it take very long?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: About twenty minutes, just relax and open wide.
lines.zh: 大概二十分鐘，放輕鬆、嘴巴張大一點。

scene_zh: 病人在眼科診所進行視力檢查
image_prompt_en: A chibi optometrist points at an eye chart on the wall while a chibi patient sits in a chair wearing a trial frame with lenses.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you read the smallest line you can see?
lines.zh: 可以唸出你看得到的最小那一行嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The letters get blurry after the fourth line.
lines.zh: 第四行以後的字就變模糊了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's normal, let's try a stronger lens.
lines.zh: 這很正常，我們換一副度數強一點的鏡片試試。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's much clearer now, thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, your prescription has changed slightly this year.
lines.zh: 很好，你的度數今年有稍微改變。

scene_zh: 顧客告知服務生自己對特定食物過敏
image_prompt_en: A chibi waiter holds a notepad next to a chibi customer at a restaurant table, pointing to a menu item while the customer shakes their head.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have any food allergies I should know about?
lines.zh: 請問您有什麼食物過敏需要我注意的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I'm allergic to peanuts and shellfish.
lines.zh: 有，我對花生和帶殼海鮮過敏。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for letting me know, I'll tell the kitchen.
lines.zh: 謝謝告知，我會轉達廚房。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Is the peanut sauce used in any other dishes?
lines.zh: 花生醬有用在其他菜色裡嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No, only in that one dish you avoided.
lines.zh: 沒有，只有您避開的那道菜有用到。

scene_zh: 病人向醫生描述反覆胃痛的情況
image_prompt_en: A chibi patient sits on an exam table holding their stomach while a chibi doctor gently presses on the abdomen area to check for pain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Where exactly does it hurt when you press here?
lines.zh: 我按這裡的時候，你哪裡會痛？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Right around my belly button, it's a dull ache.
lines.zh: 肚臍周圍，是那種悶悶的痛。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Has this happened often after eating spicy food?
lines.zh: 吃辣的食物之後常常會這樣嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, especially after dinner most nights.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's avoid spicy food and see if it improves.
lines.zh: 我們先避開辣的食物，看看會不會改善。

scene_zh: 家長帶發燒的孩子就診並描述症狀
image_prompt_en: A chibi parent holds a small chibi child on their lap while a chibi pediatrician checks the child's forehead with a thermometer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long has your daughter had this fever?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Since last night, it's been around thirty-eight degrees.
lines.zh: 從昨天晚上開始，大概三十八度左右。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Has she had any other symptoms besides the fever?
lines.zh: 除了發燒還有其他症狀嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: She's been a little tired and not eating much.
lines.zh: 她有點沒精神，也吃得很少。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's do a quick check and take her temperature.
lines.zh: 我幫她簡單檢查一下，量個體溫。

scene_zh: 球員扭傷腳踝後尋求隊醫協助
image_prompt_en: A chibi athlete in a jersey sits on a bench holding a swollen ankle while a chibi sports doctor wraps it with a bandage.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I twisted my ankle playing basketball this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午打籃球扭到腳踝了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you put any weight on it right now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: A little, but it swells up when I stand.
lines.zh: 一點點可以，但站起來就會腫。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We'll wrap it and get an X-ray to be safe.
lines.zh: 我們先包紮，然後照個X光確認一下比較安全。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long should I stay off the court?

scene_zh: 病人在復健室進行物理治療訓練
image_prompt_en: A chibi physical therapist guides a chibi patient's arm through a stretching exercise on a padded therapy table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How does your shoulder feel after last week's session?
lines.zh: 上禮拜治療之後你的肩膀感覺如何？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Better, but it's still stiff in the morning.
lines.zh: 好一點了，但早上還是會僵硬。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's stretch it slowly before we start today.
lines.zh: 我們今天開始前先慢慢伸展一下。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, tell me if I'm doing it right.
lines.zh: 好，動作不對記得告訴我。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That looks good, hold this position for ten seconds.
lines.zh: 這樣很好，維持這個姿勢十秒鐘。

scene_zh: 民眾到健身房櫃台辦理會員申請
image_prompt_en: A chibi front-desk staff member at a gym counter shows a chibi customer a membership tablet while gym equipment is visible behind them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to sign up for a monthly membership.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, would you like access to the pool too?
lines.zh: 好的，需要加購游泳池的使用權限嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, please add that to my plan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great, here's the waiver form to sign first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you offer a free orientation tour?
lines.zh: 有提供免費的環境介紹嗎？

scene_zh: 學員與健身教練討論訓練目標
image_prompt_en: A chibi personal trainer holding a clipboard talks with a chibi client standing next to dumbbells in a gym.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What are your main fitness goals for this year?
lines.zh: 你今年主要想達成什麼健身目標？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I want to build some muscle and lose weight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you had any injuries I should know about?
lines.zh: 有什麼舊傷需要我注意的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: My lower back gets sore sometimes when I lift.
lines.zh: 我舉重的時候下背偶爾會痠。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, we'll focus on proper form first.
lines.zh: 了解，我們先從正確姿勢開始練習。

scene_zh: 新學員詢問瑜珈課程的注意事項
image_prompt_en: A chibi yoga instructor demonstrates a stretching pose on a mat while a chibi new student watches and copies the movement in a bright studio.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is this your first time joining a yoga class?
lines.zh: 這是你第一次上瑜珈課嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I'm not very flexible, honestly.
lines.zh: 對，老實說我柔軟度不太好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No worries, just move at your own pace.
lines.zh: 沒關係，照自己的節奏動作就好。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Should I bring my own mat next time?
lines.zh: 下次要自己帶瑜珈墊嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We have extra mats if you don't have one.
lines.zh: 如果沒有的話我們有備用的墊子。

scene_zh: 民眾到醫院進行例行健康檢查
image_prompt_en: A chibi nurse measures a chibi patient's height and weight on a medical scale in a hospital checkup room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Please step on the scale for your weight first.
lines.zh: 請先站上體重計量一下體重。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, should I take off my shoes?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, that gives us a more accurate reading.
lines.zh: 要，這樣數字會比較準確。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How many stations do I need to visit today?
lines.zh: 今天總共要跑幾個檢查站？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Five stations, starting with blood pressure next.

scene_zh: 病人在檢驗室進行抽血檢查
image_prompt_en: A chibi lab technician wraps a tourniquet around a seated chibi patient's arm and prepares a syringe for a blood draw.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm just going to draw a small blood sample.
lines.zh: 我要幫你抽一點血液檢體。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, I'm a little nervous about needles.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It'll only take a few seconds, try to relax.
lines.zh: 只要幾秒鐘就好，放輕鬆。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: When will the results be ready?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You can check them online in three days.
lines.zh: 三天後就可以上網查結果。

scene_zh: 民眾在診所施打流感疫苗前的問診
image_prompt_en: A chibi nurse holds a small syringe near a chibi patient's rolled-up sleeve in a clinic vaccination room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you here for the flu shot today?
lines.zh: 您今天是要來打流感疫苗嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, is there anything I should tell you first?
lines.zh: 對，有什麼事情需要先告訴你嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have any allergies to eggs or medications?
lines.zh: 你對雞蛋或藥物有過敏嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No allergies that I know of.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, you might feel a small pinch now.
lines.zh: 很好，現在可能會感覺到一點小小的刺痛。

scene_zh: 病人在醫院櫃台辦理報到並出示健保卡
image_prompt_en: A chibi receptionist behind a hospital front desk scans a small card handed over by a chibi patient standing at the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could I have your insurance card, please?
lines.zh: 可以麻煩給我您的健保卡嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Here it is, along with my ID card.
lines.zh: 這是我的健保卡，還有身分證。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, please have a seat and we'll call you.
lines.zh: 謝謝，請先坐一下，我們會叫號。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About how long is the wait today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Around twenty minutes based on the current queue.
lines.zh: 依目前排隊人數大概二十分鐘。

scene_zh: 病人向藥師詢問新藥可能的副作用
image_prompt_en: A chibi pharmacist points to a medicine label while a chibi patient at the counter listens with a curious expression.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are there any side effects I should watch for?
lines.zh: 這個藥有什麼副作用是我需要注意的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It may cause some drowsiness for the first few days.
lines.zh: 前幾天可能會有點嗜睡。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should I avoid driving after taking it?
lines.zh: 吃完藥之後應該避免開車嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, especially until you know how it affects you.
lines.zh: 對，至少要先知道自己的反應再說。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, I'll be careful the first night.
lines.zh: 謝謝，我第一晚會特別小心。

scene_zh: 訪客到醫院探望住院的朋友
image_prompt_en: A chibi visitor holding a small bouquet of flowers sits beside a chibi patient resting in a hospital bed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How are you feeling since the surgery?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Much better, the pain has mostly gone away.
lines.zh: 好很多了，痛的感覺大部分都消失了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I brought you some flowers and your favorite book.
lines.zh: 我帶了花和你最喜歡的書來給你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's so thoughtful, thank you for coming.
lines.zh: 你真貼心，謝謝你來看我。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course, let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: 當然，需要什麼儘管跟我說。

scene_zh: 朋友之間聊聊最近的壓力與心理狀態
image_prompt_en: Two chibi friends sit together on a park bench, one listening with a caring expression while the other talks with hands clasped.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You seem a bit down lately, is everything okay?
lines.zh: 你最近看起來有點低落，還好嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I've just been really stressed about work.
lines.zh: 我最近工作壓力真的很大。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you want to talk about what's bothering you?
lines.zh: 你想聊聊是什麼事困擾你嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe later, I just need to breathe right now.
lines.zh: 也許晚點吧，我現在只想喘口氣。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, I'm here whenever you're ready.
lines.zh: 沒關係，你準備好了我隨時都在。

scene_zh: 病人因扭傷腳踝到放射科照X光
image_prompt_en: A chibi radiology technician positions a chibi patient's foot on an X-ray machine table in a hospital imaging room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Please place your foot flat on the table here.
lines.zh: 請把腳平放在這個台面上。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Like this? It's a bit hard to bend.
lines.zh: 這樣嗎？彎起來有點困難。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, just hold still for a moment.
lines.zh: 這樣就可以了，保持不動一下下。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Will the results tell if it's broken?
lines.zh: 報告會顯示有沒有骨折嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, the doctor will explain the images shortly.
lines.zh: 會，醫生等等會跟你解說片子。

scene_zh: 民眾透過手機App申請處方藥續領
image_prompt_en: A chibi character sits on a couch holding a phone displaying a pharmacy app icon, with a medicine bottle on the coffee table nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to refill my blood pressure medication.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You can request that through our app now.
lines.zh: 您現在可以透過我們的App申請。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, how long until it's ready to pick up?
lines.zh: 太好了，多久之後可以來領藥？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Usually within one business day.
lines.zh: 通常一個工作天內就會好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll come by tomorrow afternoon then.
lines.zh: 那我明天下午再過來拿。

scene_zh: 顧客向藥師描述感冒症狀並詢問用藥建議
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer with a tissue in hand talks to a chibi pharmacist standing beside a shelf of cold medicine boxes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have a runny nose and a bit of a cough.
lines.zh: 我流鼻水，還有一點咳嗽。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you have a fever or sore throat as well?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No fever, just feeling stuffy and tired.
lines.zh: 沒有發燒，只是覺得鼻塞又累。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: This cold medicine should help with those symptoms.
lines.zh: 這款感冒藥應該可以緩解這些症狀。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How many times a day should I take it?

scene_zh: 求職者到醫院進行新職員工健康檢查
image_prompt_en: A chibi doctor listens to a chibi job applicant's heartbeat with a stethoscope in a bright examination room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This checkup is required for your new job, right?
lines.zh: 這次檢查是你新工作要求的，對吧？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I need the results by next Monday.
lines.zh: 對，我下週一之前就需要報告。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No problem, we'll have it ready in time.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我們會準時弄好給你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do I need to fast before the blood test?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, please don't eat after midnight tonight.
lines.zh: 要，請今晚十二點後不要進食。

scene_zh: 病人向皮膚科醫生描述手臂上的紅疹
image_prompt_en: A chibi dermatologist examines a red rash on a chibi patient's arm using a small magnifying tool in a clinic.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: When did this rash on your arm first appear?
lines.zh: 你手臂上的疹子什麼時候開始出現的？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About three days ago, and it's really itchy.
lines.zh: 大概三天前，而且真的很癢。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you used any new soap or lotion recently?
lines.zh: 最近有換新的肥皂或乳液嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Actually, yes, I bought a new body wash.
lines.zh: 有，我最近買了新的沐浴乳。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's likely the cause, let's stop using it.
lines.zh: 那很可能就是原因，先停用看看。

scene_zh: 上班族因久坐辦公室出現背痛症狀就診
image_prompt_en: A chibi office worker sits hunched at a desk rubbing their lower back, while a chibi doctor across the room takes notes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My lower back has been aching for two weeks.
lines.zh: 我的下背已經痛兩個禮拜了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you sit at a desk for long hours?
lines.zh: 你是不是久坐辦公桌很長時間？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, about eight hours a day at a computer.
lines.zh: 對，每天大概坐八小時盯電腦。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Try standing up and stretching every hour or so.
lines.zh: 試著每隔一小時站起來伸展一下。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll set a reminder on my phone for that.
lines.zh: 我會在手機上設個提醒。

scene_zh: 病人向醫生尋求戒菸建議與協助
image_prompt_en: A chibi doctor hands a chibi patient a nicotine patch box across a desk, with a crossed-out cigarette icon on a wall poster.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I've decided I really want to quit smoking.
lines.zh: 我決定要下定決心戒菸了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's great news, how many years have you smoked?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Almost ten years, about a pack a day.
lines.zh: 快十年了，一天大概一包。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We can start with a nicotine patch program.
lines.zh: 我們可以先從尼古丁貼片療程開始。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What side effects should I expect from the patch?
lines.zh: 貼片可能會有什麼副作用？

scene_zh: 民眾打電話到診所預約流感疫苗接種時段
image_prompt_en: A chibi character talks on the phone at home, while a small calendar icon and a syringe icon float above showing an appointment scene.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to book a flu shot appointment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We have openings every morning this week.
lines.zh: 我們這週每天早上都有名額。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I come in tomorrow around nine?
lines.zh: 我明天九點左右可以來嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, please bring your health insurance card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, see you tomorrow morning.

scene_zh: 民眾向營養師諮詢日常飲食調整建議
image_prompt_en: A chibi nutritionist points to a food pyramid chart on the wall while a chibi client sits across the desk taking notes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like some advice on eating more balanced meals.
lines.zh: 我想請教怎麼吃得更均衡一點。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you tell me what a typical day looks like?
lines.zh: 可以說說你平常一天大概吃什麼嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I usually skip breakfast and eat a big dinner.
lines.zh: 我通常不吃早餐，晚餐吃很多。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's try adding a small breakfast first.
lines.zh: 我們先試著加一份簡單的早餐。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What kind of breakfast would you recommend?
lines.zh: 你會建議吃什麼樣的早餐？

scene_zh: 病人回診向醫生報告治療後的恢復情況
image_prompt_en: A chibi doctor reviews a chart on a clipboard while a chibi patient sits across the desk describing how they feel.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How have you been feeling since your last visit?
lines.zh: 上次回診之後你感覺怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Much better, the medication really helped.
lines.zh: 好很多了，藥物真的有幫助。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Any remaining symptoms we should keep an eye on?
lines.zh: 還有什麼殘留症狀需要留意的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a little fatigue in the evenings.
lines.zh: 只有晚上還是有點疲倦。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's schedule one more check-up in a month.
lines.zh: 我們一個月後再安排一次回診檢查。

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行櫃檯申請開立新的存款帳戶。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank teller hands a chibi customer a blank account application form across a counter with a computer and a small ID card tray.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to open a checking account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, do you have your ID with you?
lines.zh: 好的，請問您有帶身分證嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, here it is.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great, please fill out this form.
lines.zh: 太好了，請填寫這張表格。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure, how long will it take?

scene_zh: 顧客的提款卡被自動提款機吞卡，前往詢問處理方式。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer stares worriedly at an ATM screen while a chibi bank clerk points at the card slot with a concerned expression.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The machine just swallowed my card.
lines.zh: 這台機器把我的卡吃掉了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Don't worry, we can retrieve it inside.
lines.zh: 別擔心，我們可以在裡面取回。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long does that usually take?
lines.zh: 這通常要花多久時間呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a few minutes, please have a seat.
lines.zh: 只要幾分鐘，請先坐一下。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, I'll wait here.

scene_zh: 顧客請銀行行員協助辦理國際匯款。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank clerk types on a keyboard while a chibi customer holds a slip of paper with an account number, both looking at a screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to wire money to another country.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, what's the recipient's account number?
lines.zh: 好的，請問收款人的帳號是？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's written on this paper.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it, there's a small transfer fee.
lines.zh: 收到了，這會收取一筆小額手續費。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, please go ahead.

scene_zh: 旅客到銀行櫃檯兌換出國要用的外幣。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer places colorful foreign banknotes on the counter while a chibi teller counts local bills with a small calculator nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to exchange some dollars.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How much would you like to exchange?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: About five hundred dollars, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Today's rate is thirty-one point two.
lines.zh: 今天的匯率是三十一點二。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That works for me, thanks.

scene_zh: 顧客發現信用卡不見了，打電話向銀行掛失。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer holds a phone to their ear with a worried face while an empty wallet lies open on the table beside them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to report my credit card missing.
lines.zh: 我需要掛失我的信用卡。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that, let me help.
lines.zh: 很遺憾聽到這消息，我來協助您。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you cancel it right away?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it's already been blocked.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, that's a huge relief.
lines.zh: 謝謝，這樣我就放心多了。

scene_zh: 顧客發現帳單上有不認識的扣款，向銀行提出申訴。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer points at a printed statement with a confused frown while a chibi bank clerk looks at the same paper on the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I don't recognize this charge on my statement.
lines.zh: 我對帳單上這筆扣款沒有印象。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me take a look at that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It was charged last Tuesday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We'll open a dispute for you.
lines.zh: 我們會幫您提出爭議申訴。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long will the investigation take?
lines.zh: 調查大概需要多久時間？

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局櫃檯寄送一個包裹到外縣市。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer sets a taped cardboard box on a postal scale while a chibi clerk enters details on a computer behind the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to mail this package, please.
lines.zh: 我想寄這個包裹，麻煩你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, where is it headed?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's going to Kaohsiung.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That'll be one hundred and twenty dollars.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you go, thank you.

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局窗口購買郵票貼在明信片上。
image_prompt_en: A chibi postal clerk hands a small sheet of colorful stamps to a chibi customer who holds a stack of postcards.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I get five stamps, please?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, are these for domestic mail?
lines.zh: 好的，這是要寄國內信件嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, all within Taiwan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That comes to forty dollars total.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, here's the cash.

scene_zh: 顧客打電話向郵局詢問包裹目前的配送狀況。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer holds a phone while looking at a tracking number written on a receipt, with a small delivery truck icon beside them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you tell me where my parcel is?
lines.zh: 可以告訴我我的包裹在哪裡嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, what's your tracking number?
lines.zh: 好的，請問您的追蹤號碼是？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's on the receipt, one moment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's out for delivery today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, thanks for checking.

scene_zh: 顧客收到未能簽收的包裹通知單，前往郵局補領包裹。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer hands a yellow missed-delivery slip to a chibi postal worker who is retrieving a box from a shelf behind the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I got a notice for a missed delivery.
lines.zh: 我收到一張未能簽收的通知單。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you have the slip with you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, right here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll go grab your package now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, I appreciate it.

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局窗口繳交水電費帳單。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer places a folded utility bill and cash on the counter while a chibi clerk stamps a receipt with a small ink stamp.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to pay this electric bill.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, the total is eight hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sorry, cash only for this counter.
lines.zh: 不好意思，這個窗口只收現金。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No problem, here you go.

scene_zh: 民眾到市立圖書館櫃檯辦理圖書證延期。
image_prompt_en: A chibi librarian scans an expired library card at a small counter while a chibi patron waits with a stack of returned books.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My library card just expired.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem, I can renew it now.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我現在就能幫您更新。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do I need to fill anything out?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just confirm your current address.
lines.zh: 只要確認您目前的住址就好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's still the same, thanks.

scene_zh: 民眾到戶政事務所申請戶籍謄本。
image_prompt_en: A chibi clerk hands a printed official document across a city hall counter to a chibi citizen holding an ID card and a numbered ticket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need a copy of my household certificate.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, may I see your ID card?
lines.zh: 好的，可以看一下您的身分證嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here it is.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: This will take about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, I'll wait.

scene_zh: 民眾到簽證辦事處詢問申請所需文件。
image_prompt_en: A chibi visitor talks to a chibi visa officer behind a glass window counter, holding a folder of passport documents.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What documents do I need for a visa?
lines.zh: 申請簽證需要哪些文件？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You'll need your passport and a photo.
lines.zh: 您需要護照和一張照片。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do I need proof of income too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, a bank statement works fine.
lines.zh: 是的，銀行對帳單就可以。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, I'll bring that next time.

scene_zh: 顧客到電信公司門市詢問帳單金額異常的問題。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer shows a phone bill on a tablet screen to a chibi telecom staff member behind a service desk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My phone bill seems higher than usual.
lines.zh: 我的電話帳單好像比平常高。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me check your account details.
lines.zh: 我來查一下您的帳戶明細。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I didn't use any extra data.
lines.zh: 我沒有用超過額外的流量。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It looks like an international call charge.
lines.zh: 看起來是一筆國際電話的費用。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ah, that explains it, thanks.
lines.zh: 啊，這樣就說得通了，謝謝。

scene_zh: 顧客請銀行人員協助設定手機行動支付功能。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank staff member points at a smartphone screen showing a mobile payment app while a chibi customer watches closely.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you help me set up mobile payment?
lines.zh: 可以幫我設定行動支付嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, please open your banking app.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, it's open now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Tap the link card option here.
lines.zh: 點這裡的綁定卡片選項。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, this is easier than I thought.
lines.zh: 了解，比我想的簡單多了。

scene_zh: 顧客發現附近的提款機沒有現金可以領取。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer frowns at an ATM screen showing an empty cash tray while another chibi person waits behind in line.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This ATM says it's out of cash.
lines.zh: 這台提款機顯示現金已用完。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Try the branch across the street.
lines.zh: 你可以試試對街的分行。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is that one usually stocked?
lines.zh: 那台通常有補足現金嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it gets refilled every morning.
lines.zh: 有，它每天早上都會補鈔。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, I'll head over there.

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行櫃檯將支票兌換成現金。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer slides a signed check across the counter while a chibi teller counts banknotes with a small money-counting machine nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to cash this check.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, please sign it on the back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Done, here you go.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How would you like the cash?
lines.zh: 您想要怎麼樣的現金面額？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Mostly large bills, please.

scene_zh: 顧客向銀行人員詢問跨行轉帳的手續費用。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer points at a fee chart poster on the wall while a chibi bank clerk explains with a small calculator in hand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What's the fee for a bank transfer?
lines.zh: 銀行轉帳的手續費是多少？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's fifteen dollars for other banks.
lines.zh: 轉到其他銀行是十五元。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it free within the same bank?
lines.zh: 同一家銀行轉帳是免費的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, that transfer has no charge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good to know, thank you.

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局詢問並申請租用個人信箱。
image_prompt_en: A chibi postal clerk shows a small wall of numbered mailboxes to a chibi customer holding a rental application form.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to rent a mailbox here.
lines.zh: 我想在這裡租一個信箱。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, we have a few sizes available.
lines.zh: 好的，我們有幾種尺寸可以選。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: A small one should be enough.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's two hundred dollars a year.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds fair, I'll take it.
lines.zh: 聽起來合理，我要租這個。

scene_zh: 民眾到外交部辦事處申請新護照。
image_prompt_en: A chibi officer examines a passport photo and application form handed over by a chibi citizen at a government counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to apply for a new passport.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you have your photo and ID?
lines.zh: 您有帶照片和身分證嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, both are right here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It'll be ready in ten business days.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, that works for my schedule.
lines.zh: 太好了，這樣配合我的行程。

scene_zh: 顧客請銀行協助設定每月電費的自動扣款。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank clerk points at a form with a checkbox for automatic payments while a chibi customer signs it with a pen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I set up automatic bill payments?
lines.zh: 我可以設定自動扣繳帳單嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, which bill would you like linked?
lines.zh: 好的，您想連結哪一筆帳單？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My monthly electric bill.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Please sign this authorization form.
lines.zh: 請在這張授權書上簽名。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Done, thanks for setting that up.

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行櫃檯提領較大金額的現金。
image_prompt_en: A chibi teller stacks bundles of cash on the counter while a chibi customer holds an open bag ready to put the money inside.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to withdraw a large amount.
lines.zh: 我想提領一筆較大金額的現金。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, how much do you need?
lines.zh: 好的，請問您需要多少呢？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Around three hundred thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We'll need a few minutes to prepare it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, take your time.

scene_zh: 顧客到自動櫃員機前查詢自己的帳戶餘額。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer looks closely at an ATM screen showing a balance figure while holding their bank card in the other hand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I just want to check my balance.
lines.zh: 我只是想查一下我的餘額。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Insert your card and enter your pin.
lines.zh: 請插入卡片並輸入密碼。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, I've done that.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Select balance inquiry on the screen.
lines.zh: 在螢幕上選擇餘額查詢。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, thanks for the help.

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行申請訂購新的支票簿。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank clerk shows a sample checkbook design to a chibi customer sitting at the service desk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to order a new checkbook.
lines.zh: 我需要訂購一本新的支票簿。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, how many books would you like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Just one for now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It'll arrive by mail in a week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That works great, thank you.

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行諮詢並申請個人小額貸款。
image_prompt_en: A chibi loan officer explains numbers on a printed sheet to a chibi customer sitting across a small office desk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm interested in applying for a loan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, what's the loan amount you need?
lines.zh: 好的，您需要的貸款金額是多少？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: About two hundred thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll need to see your income proof.
lines.zh: 我需要看一下您的收入證明。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have it right here.

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行更新自己的電話與地址資料。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank clerk types on a computer while a chibi customer reads a new address off a phone to update the record.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to update my phone number.
lines.zh: 我需要更新我的電話號碼。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, what's the new number?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's zero nine one two, three four five.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it, anything else to update?
lines.zh: 收到了，還有其他要更新的嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My address changed too, actually.

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局辦理退回一件不需要的包裹。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer hands a taped box with a return label to a chibi postal clerk standing behind the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to return this package.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, do you have the return label?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, it's already attached.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great, that'll be free of charge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, thanks for your help.

scene_zh: 顧客到郵局窗口寄送重要文件的掛號信。
image_prompt_en: A chibi customer hands a sealed envelope to a chibi postal worker who stamps it with a registered mail stamp.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to send this as registered mail.
lines.zh: 我想把這封寄成掛號信。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, that includes tracking and a signature.
lines.zh: 好的，這樣有追蹤和簽收服務。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much extra does that cost?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: An additional thirty dollars.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's fine, please send it that way.
lines.zh: 沒問題，麻煩用這種方式寄。

scene_zh: 顧客到銀行辦理結清並關閉舊帳戶。
image_prompt_en: A chibi bank clerk stamps a closure form while a chibi customer hands over an old bank card across the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to close this account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: May I ask the reason for closing?
lines.zh: 可以請問結清的原因嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm moving to another bank.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Understood, please sign this closure form.
lines.zh: 了解，請在這張結清單上簽名。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Done, thanks for your help today.
lines.zh: 好了，謝謝你今天的協助。

scene_zh: 新鄰居剛搬進隔壁，兩人在走廊初次見面打招呼。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters shake hands in an apartment hallway, one holding a moving box, doormat and potted plant nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Jake.
lines.zh: 嗨，我們好像還沒見過面，我是傑克。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Mia. I just moved in.
lines.zh: 很高興認識你，我是米亞，剛搬進來。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Welcome to the building! Let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: 歡迎搬進來！有需要幫忙儘管說。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's so kind, thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No problem. See you around!

scene_zh: 在派對上把兩位互不認識的朋友介紹給彼此。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters stand at a party while a third points between them making an introduction, balloons and snack table in background.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sam, this is my friend Lily from work.
lines.zh: 山姆，這是我的朋友莉莉，我同事。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hey Lily, great to finally meet you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: She's been wanting to meet you too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I've heard so many good things about you.
lines.zh: 我聽過好多關於你的好事。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: All good, I promise!

scene_zh: 兩人在公車站等車時閒聊天氣。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters stand under umbrellas at a bus stop, rain falling around them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you believe how much it's rained this week?
lines.zh: 你相信這週雨下得這麼大嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I know, my shoes are still wet from yesterday.
lines.zh: 對啊，我的鞋子昨天到現在都還沒乾。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: They say it should clear up by the weekend.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I hope so, I have plans outdoors.
lines.zh: 希望啦，我週末有戶外的計畫。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fingers crossed for you then.

scene_zh: 男生鼓起勇氣邀請同事下班後一起喝咖啡。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters chat near an office coffee machine, one holding two paper cups.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Would you like to grab coffee sometime this week?
lines.zh: 這週要不要找時間一起喝杯咖啡？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, that sounds nice. When works for you?
lines.zh: 好啊，聽起來不錯，你什麼時候方便？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How about Thursday afternoon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thursday works for me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, I'll text you the place.
lines.zh: 太好了，我再傳訊息告訴你地點。

scene_zh: 朋友邀請週末聚餐，但她剛好有事無法出席。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters talk on a video call, one showing a calendar on a laptop screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We're having dinner Saturday, can you make it?
lines.zh: 我們星期六要聚餐，你能來嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm sorry, I already have plans that night.
lines.zh: 抱歉，那天晚上我已經有安排了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No worries, maybe next time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Definitely, thanks for inviting me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course, have a good weekend.

scene_zh: 帶著禮物抵達朋友的生日派對現場。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a front door with balloons and a birthday banner, one holding a wrapped gift.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Happy birthday! Sorry I'm a little late.
lines.zh: 生日快樂！抱歉我來晚了一點。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You made it, that's all that matters.
lines.zh: 你來了就好，這才是重點。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I got you something small.
lines.zh: 我帶了一份小禮物給你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You didn't have to, but thank you!
lines.zh: 你不用這麼客氣的，謝謝你！

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Come on, let's join the others.

scene_zh: 到朋友的新家做客，帶了一份喬遷禮物。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a new apartment doorway with unpacked boxes visible inside, one handing over a wrapped plant.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Welcome to your new place! This is for you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, a plant! I love it, thank you.
lines.zh: 哇，一盆植物！我好喜歡，謝謝你。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It felt empty without something green.
lines.zh: 覺得少了點綠意會怪怪的。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Come in, let me show you around.
lines.zh: 進來吧，我帶你參觀一下。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd love that, it looks amazing already.
lines.zh: 好啊，看起來已經很棒了。

scene_zh: 在辦公室看到同事今天穿得特別好看，忍不住稱讚。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters in an office, one gesturing admiringly at the other's stylish outfit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I really like your outfit today.
lines.zh: 我今天真的很喜歡你的穿搭。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks! I just picked this up last week.
lines.zh: 謝謝！這是我上禮拜才買的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The color suits you so well.
lines.zh: 這個顏色真的很適合你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That means a lot, thank you.
lines.zh: 聽你這麼說我很開心，謝謝。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You should wear it more often.

scene_zh: 因為塞車遲到，跟等候多時的朋友道歉。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters meet outside a cafe, one out of breath and checking a wristwatch apologetically.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm so sorry I'm late, traffic was terrible.
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉遲到了，路上塞爆了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's okay, I just got here myself.
lines.zh: 沒關係，我自己也才剛到。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I hope you weren't waiting too long.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not at all, don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for understanding, let's go inside.
lines.zh: 謝謝你體諒，我們進去吧。

title_en: Catching Up With an Old Friend
scene_zh: 多年不見的朋友在街上巧遇，聊起近況。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters hug on a sidewalk with shopping bags, both smiling in surprise.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh my gosh, it's been forever!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I know, how have you been?
lines.zh: 對啊，你最近過得怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Pretty good, I changed jobs last year.
lines.zh: 還不錯，我去年換了工作。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's exciting, we should catch up properly.
lines.zh: 太棒了，我們應該好好聚一聚。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's grab lunch this weekend.

scene_zh: 研討會結束後，兩人互加聯絡方式保持聯繫。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters hold up smartphones toward each other at a conference booth, name badges on their shirts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It was great talking to you. Can I get your number?
lines.zh: 跟你聊天很開心，可以跟你要個電話嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, let's just add each other on LINE.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, scanning your code now.
lines.zh: 太好了，我現在掃你的條碼。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it, I'll message you later.
lines.zh: 加好了，我等等傳訊息給你。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds good, talk soon.

scene_zh: 想請鄰居幫忙代收包裹。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters talk at an apartment door, a delivery box sitting on the floor between them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you do me a favor this weekend?
lines.zh: 這週末可以幫我一個忙嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, what do you need?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you grab my package if it arrives?
lines.zh: 如果包裹送到了，可以幫我收一下嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem at all, happy to help.
lines.zh: 完全沒問題，很樂意幫忙。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You're a lifesaver, thank you.

scene_zh: 朋友幫忙搬家後，特地表達感謝。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters stand beside a moving truck, one handing the other a drink as thanks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I really appreciate you helping me move.
lines.zh: 真的很感謝你幫我搬家。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was nothing, that's what friends are for.
lines.zh: 這沒什麼，朋友就是要互相幫忙。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I couldn't have done it without you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You'd do the same for me.
lines.zh: 換作是我你也會這樣做的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let me buy you lunch as thanks.
lines.zh: 讓我請你吃頓午餐表達感謝。

scene_zh: 朋友分手後心情低落，前來陪伴安慰。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters sit on a park bench, one offering a tissue while the other looks down sadly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I heard about the breakup. Are you okay?
lines.zh: 我聽說你們分手了，你還好嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really, it's been a rough week.
lines.zh: 不太好，這禮拜真的很難熬。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm really sorry you're going through this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks for being here for me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Anytime, call me whenever you need to talk.
lines.zh: 隨時都可以，想聊聊就打給我。

scene_zh: 得知同事升職，特地道賀。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters in an office, one holding a congratulations card and clapping.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I heard you got promoted, congratulations!
lines.zh: 聽說你升職了，恭喜恭喜！

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you so much, I'm still surprised.
lines.zh: 太謝謝你了，我到現在還有點驚訝。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You totally deserve it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That means a lot coming from you.
lines.zh: 聽你這麼說對我意義重大。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We should celebrate this weekend.
lines.zh: 我們這週末應該慶祝一下。

scene_zh: 在婚宴上與不熟識的賓客攀談。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters in formal outfits chat at a wedding reception table with flowers and place cards.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do you know the bride and groom?
lines.zh: 你是怎麼認識新郎新娘的？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I went to college with the bride.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Small world, I work with the groom.
lines.zh: 世界真小，我跟新郎是同事。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's so nice, they make a great couple.
lines.zh: 太好了，他們真的很登對。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Definitely, let's toast to them.
lines.zh: 沒錯，我們敬他們一杯吧。

scene_zh: 必須告訴朋友一個不太好的消息，盡量委婉表達。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters sit across a table, one gently placing a hand near the other's arm while speaking softly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have something to tell you, and it's not great news.
lines.zh: 我有件事要告訴你，不是什麼好消息。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, go ahead, I'm listening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The trip got canceled due to the weather.
lines.zh: 旅行因為天氣的關係取消了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh no, that's really disappointing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I know, let's plan another one soon.
lines.zh: 我懂，我們盡快再安排一次吧。

scene_zh: 兩位朋友討論週末要一起做什麼活動。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters look at a phone together on a sofa, a weekend activity list visible on screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Any plans for the weekend yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really, do you have something in mind?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How about hiking on Saturday morning?
lines.zh: 星期六早上去爬山如何？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That sounds fun, count me in.
lines.zh: 聽起來很有趣，我要參加。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, I'll pick you up at eight.

scene_zh: 聚會快結束時，禮貌地道別離開。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a party doorway, one waving goodbye while putting on a jacket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It was great chatting with you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Same here, are you heading out?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, I have an early start tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Get home safe, let's keep in touch.
lines.zh: 路上小心，我們保持聯絡。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Will do, take care!

scene_zh: 新年前互相拜訪並互道祝福。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters exchange small gift bags in front of a decorated doorway with lanterns.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Happy New Year! Wishing you all the best.
lines.zh: 新年快樂！祝你一切順利。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Same to you, thanks for coming by.
lines.zh: 你也是，謝謝你特地過來。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I brought a little something for the family.
lines.zh: 我帶了一點小東西給你們家。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're too generous, thank you so much.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Enjoy the holidays with your family.

scene_zh: 第一天上班向新同事自我介紹。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters shake hands beside an office desk with a computer and plant.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'm Ken, starting today on the marketing team.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是肯，今天開始加入行銷團隊。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Welcome aboard, I'm Amy from design.
lines.zh: 歡迎加入，我是設計部的艾咪。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice to meet you, any tips for a new guy?
lines.zh: 很高興認識你，對新人有什麼建議嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just ask questions, everyone here is friendly.
lines.zh: 多問問題就對了，大家都很友善。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good to know, thanks for the welcome.

scene_zh: 午休時間邀請同事一起吃飯。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters stand by an office cafeteria, one pointing toward the food line with a smile.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Want to grab lunch together today?
lines.zh: 今天要不要一起吃午餐？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, where are you thinking?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: There's a new noodle place nearby.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm in, let's leave around noon.
lines.zh: 我加入，我們中午出發吧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, I'll meet you at the elevator.
lines.zh: 太好了，我在電梯口等你。

scene_zh: 同事剛度假回來，好奇地問起旅程。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters chat at a desk, one showing vacation photos on a phone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How was your trip? I saw your photos.
lines.zh: 你的旅行怎麼樣？我看到你的照片了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was amazing, the beaches were beautiful.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That sounds so relaxing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It really was, I needed the break.
lines.zh: 真的，我很需要那段休息。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You deserve it, welcome back.
lines.zh: 你值得這樣的假期，歡迎回來。

scene_zh: 第一次見到朋友的新男友。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters shake hands at a restaurant table while a third smiles between them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So this must be the famous boyfriend.
lines.zh: 這位就是傳說中的男朋友了吧。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Guilty as charged, nice to finally meet you.
lines.zh: 沒錯，終於見到你了真好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: She talks about you all the time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: All good things, I hope.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course, come sit with us.
lines.zh: 當然，過來跟我們一起坐。

title_en: Checking In on a Sick Friend
scene_zh: 朋友感冒臥床，特地打電話問候。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters video call, one lying in bed with a tissue box and blanket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I heard you're not feeling well. How are you?
lines.zh: 聽說你不太舒服，你還好嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a bad cold, I'll be fine.
lines.zh: 只是重感冒而已，我會沒事的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you need me to bring anything over?
lines.zh: 需要我帶點什麼過去嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Some soup would be really nice, thank you.
lines.zh: 如果有湯就太好了，謝謝你。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: On my way, get some rest.

scene_zh: 晚餐聚會結束後，向邀請自己的主人道謝。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a front door after dinner, one holding a coat and waving goodbye.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you so much for having us over.
lines.zh: 真的很謝謝你邀請我們過來。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm so glad you could come.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Dinner was absolutely delicious.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you, I'll walk you out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We should do this again soon.
lines.zh: 我們應該很快再聚一次。

scene_zh: 在陌生街道向路人詢問方向。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters stand on a street corner, one pointing down the road while the other holds a phone map.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the station?
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以告訴我怎麼去車站嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, just go straight and turn left.
lines.zh: 好的，直走然後左轉就到了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it far from here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About a ten minute walk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you so much for your help.
lines.zh: 真的非常謝謝你的幫忙。

scene_zh: 打電話告訴家人自己考試通過的好消息。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters on a phone call, one jumping excitedly while holding a certificate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Mom, I have great news to share!
lines.zh: 媽，我有好消息要跟妳說！

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Tell me, I can't wait to hear.
lines.zh: 快說吧，我等不及要聽了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I passed the exam I was so worried about.
lines.zh: 我通過那個讓我很擔心的考試了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm so proud of you!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks Mom, I couldn't have done it without your support.
lines.zh: 謝謝媽，沒有妳的支持我做不到。

title_en: Welcoming a Friend Back From Abroad
title_zh: 迎接從國外回來的朋友
scene_zh: 到機場接機迎接留學回國的朋友。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters hug at an airport arrival gate, one pulling a suitcase.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Welcome back! How was the flight?
lines.zh: 歡迎回來！飛行還順利嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Long, but I'm so happy to be home.
lines.zh: 很久，但我很高興回到家了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We missed you so much.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I missed everyone too, it's good to be back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's get your bags and head home.

title_en: Making a New Friend at a Gym
scene_zh: 在健身房運動時和旁邊的人聊起天來。
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters chat near gym equipment, one holding a water bottle and towel.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you come here often? I haven't seen you before.
lines.zh: 你常來這裡嗎？我之前沒看過你。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: This is actually my first week.
lines.zh: 其實這是我來的第一週。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Welcome, the classes here are really good.
lines.zh: 歡迎，這裡的課程真的很棒。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Good to know, any you'd recommend?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The morning yoga class is my favorite.
lines.zh: 早上的瑜伽課是我的最愛。

scene_zh: 爸爸叫孩子起床準備上學，時間快來不及了
image_prompt_en: A chibi dad pulls back the curtains in a bright bedroom while a sleepy chibi kid clutches a blanket in bed, a wall clock and school backpack visible nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Wake up, sweetie, you're going to be late.
lines.zh: 起床囉寶貝，你快遲到了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Five more minutes, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The bus comes in twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 公車二十分鐘後就到了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, okay, I'm getting up now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Breakfast is on the table when you're ready.
lines.zh: 早餐已經放在桌上了，準備好就吃。

scene_zh: 夫妻討論今晚要煮什麼菜
image_prompt_en: A chibi couple stands in a kitchen looking into an open fridge, one holding a recipe card, vegetables and a pot on the counter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What do you feel like eating tonight?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe stir-fried noodles? We have everything for that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds good, I'll chop the vegetables.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you also boil some water for the soup?
lines.zh: 你能順便燒點熱水煮湯嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure, dinner will be ready in thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 沒問題，晚餐三十分鐘後就好。

scene_zh: 兄妹在討論這週的家事該怎麼分配
image_prompt_en: Two chibi siblings sit at a kitchen table with a chore chart between them, one holding a mop and the other a stack of dishes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you do the dishes tonight instead of me?
lines.zh: 你今晚可以幫我洗碗嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Only if you take out the trash tomorrow.
lines.zh: 那你明天要幫我倒垃圾喔。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Deal, that sounds fair.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Don't forget to vacuum the living room too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I won't, I promise.

scene_zh: 家人出門前確認採買清單有沒有漏東西
image_prompt_en: A chibi mom checks a shopping list on her phone while a chibi kid pushes a small cart near the front door, reusable bags hanging on a hook.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Did we add milk to the list?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, and I put down eggs too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We're almost out of toilet paper as well.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me add that right now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, let's head to the store then.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我們去超市吧。

scene_zh: 媽媽發現白衣服被紅色衣服染色了
image_prompt_en: A chibi mom holds up a pink-stained white shirt in front of a washing machine, a red sock lying on top of the laundry pile.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Why is this shirt suddenly pink?
lines.zh: 這件襯衫怎麼突然變成粉紅色？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh no, I forgot to separate the colors.
lines.zh: 糟糕，我忘了分開洗深淺色衣服。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's okay, we'll be more careful next time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me try soaking it in cold water.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good idea, that might save it.
lines.zh: 好主意，說不定能救回來。

scene_zh: 家裡水龍頭漏水，請水電工來檢修
image_prompt_en: A chibi plumber kneels under a kitchen sink with a wrench while a chibi homeowner points at a dripping faucet, a small puddle on the floor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for coming so quickly today.
lines.zh: 謝謝你今天這麼快就過來。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem, where's the leak coming from?
lines.zh: 不會，請問是哪裡在漏水？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's dripping right under the kitchen sink.
lines.zh: 就在廚房水槽下面一直滴水。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I see the problem, the pipe is loose.
lines.zh: 我看到問題了，是管子鬆了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long will it take to fix?

scene_zh: 租客打電話跟房東討論房租調漲的事
image_prompt_en: A chibi tenant talks on the phone in a small apartment living room while a speech bubble shows a chibi landlord, a rent bill on the table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I got your message about the rent increase.
lines.zh: 我收到您說要調漲房租的訊息了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it goes up starting next month.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could we talk about the amount a bit?
lines.zh: 我們可以稍微談一下金額嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, let's discuss it this weekend.
lines.zh: 當然，我們這週末討論一下。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, I really appreciate that.

scene_zh: 室友晚上開音樂太大聲，另一位過來反映
image_prompt_en: A chibi roommate stands in a doorway covering one ear while another chibi roommate lowers the volume on a small speaker in a shared apartment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, could you turn the music down a bit?
lines.zh: 嘿，可以把音樂關小聲一點嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sorry, I didn't realize it was that loud.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have an early class tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries, I'll use headphones instead.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我改戴耳機好了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, I really appreciate it.

scene_zh: 搬家公司的人來幫忙搬家具到新家
image_prompt_en: Two chibi movers carry a sofa out of a house while a chibi family stands beside labeled cardboard boxes on the driveway.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Where would you like the sofa placed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Please put it against the living room wall.
lines.zh: 請放在客廳靠牆的那邊。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, and these boxes go upstairs?
lines.zh: 了解，那這些箱子要搬到樓上嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, the bedroom boxes go upstairs.
lines.zh: 對，寫臥室的箱子搬上樓。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We'll be finished within the hour.
lines.zh: 我們一小時內就能搬完。

scene_zh: 家裡網路突然斷線，打電話給網路公司客服
image_prompt_en: A chibi person sits on the floor holding a phone next to a blinking router, a laptop showing a disconnected icon on a nearby table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Our internet has been down since this morning.
lines.zh: 我們家網路從今天早上就斷了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me check the connection status for you.
lines.zh: 我幫您查一下連線狀態。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, the router lights are all off.
lines.zh: 謝謝，路由器的燈全都熄了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Please unplug it and wait thirty seconds.
lines.zh: 請把它拔掉插頭，等三十秒。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, I'll try that right away.

scene_zh: 帶生病的貓咪去動物醫院看診
image_prompt_en: A chibi vet examines a small orange cat on an exam table while a worried chibi pet owner holds a carrier, stethoscope and clipboard nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: She hasn't been eating for two days.
lines.zh: 她已經兩天沒吃東西了。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me take her temperature first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it something serious, doctor?
lines.zh: 醫生，會是什麼嚴重的問題嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It looks like a mild stomach infection.
lines.zh: 看起來是輕微的腸胃感染。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Will these medications help her recover?
lines.zh: 這些藥能幫助她康復嗎？

scene_zh: 媽媽出門前跟保母交代小孩的注意事項
image_prompt_en: A chibi mom hands a written schedule to a chibi babysitter in a living room while a toddler plays with blocks on the floor nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: His snack is in the fridge, second shelf.
lines.zh: 他的點心放在冰箱第二層。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it, and what time is his nap?
lines.zh: 了解，那他午睡時間是幾點？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Around two o'clock, he gets sleepy after lunch.
lines.zh: 大概兩點，他吃完午餐就會想睡。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perfect, I'll keep an eye on the clock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Call me if anything comes up.

scene_zh: 爸爸念床邊故事哄小孩睡覺
image_prompt_en: A chibi dad sits on the edge of a bed reading a picture book to a chibi child tucked under blankets, a night lamp glowing softly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Which story do you want tonight?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The one about the little dragon, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good choice, get comfortable under the blanket.
lines.zh: 選得好，把被子蓋好躺舒服。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you do the funny voices again?
lines.zh: 你可以再用搞笑的聲音講嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course, close your eyes and listen.
lines.zh: 當然可以，閉上眼睛聽故事囉。

scene_zh: 夫妻討論這個週末要帶孩子去哪裡玩
image_prompt_en: A chibi couple looks at a calendar and a park brochure at the kitchen table while two chibi kids excitedly point at a picture of a playground.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What should we do with the kids Saturday?
lines.zh: 星期六要帶孩子去做什麼？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How about the new park by the river?
lines.zh: 去河邊那個新公園怎麼樣？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: They would love the playground there.
lines.zh: 他們一定會喜歡那邊的遊樂設施。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's pack a picnic lunch as well.
lines.zh: 我們也帶野餐午餐去吧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds like a perfect family day.
lines.zh: 聽起來會是完美的家庭日。

scene_zh: 提醒家人今天輪到誰澆花
image_prompt_en: A chibi kid holds a watering can over flower pots on a balcony while another chibi family member checks a chore chart taped to the door.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Whose turn is it to water the plants?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I think it's my turn this week.
lines.zh: 我記得這禮拜是我的班。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The tomatoes look a little dry.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll water them right after breakfast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, don't forget the ones on the balcony.
lines.zh: 謝謝，陽台上那幾盆也別忘了。

scene_zh: 聽到垃圾車音樂，提醒家人拿垃圾出去丟
image_prompt_en: A chibi family member carries a recycling bin toward the street as a garbage truck approaches, sorted bottles and cans visible inside the bin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I hear the garbage truck coming!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Grab the recycling bin, I'll get the trash.
lines.zh: 快拿回收桶，我拿一般垃圾。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Did we separate the bottles from the cans?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, everything is already sorted.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's hurry before the truck leaves.
lines.zh: 我們動作快點，不然車子要走了。

scene_zh: 家人找不到大門鑰匙，全家一起幫忙找
image_prompt_en: A chibi person searches through a coat pocket by the front door while another chibi family member checks under couch cushions in the living room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you seen my keys anywhere?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Did you check your jacket pocket?
lines.zh: 你有檢查外套口袋了嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Not there, I already looked twice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe they fell under the couch.
lines.zh: 說不定掉到沙發底下了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Found them, they were in my bag.
lines.zh: 找到了，原來在我包包裡。

scene_zh: 送貨員送包裹到家，需要簽收確認
image_prompt_en: A chibi delivery worker hands a cardboard box to a chibi resident at the open front door, a delivery scanner and clipboard in hand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Delivery for apartment three, is this correct?
lines.zh: 這裡是三樓的包裹，對嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, that's me, thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Could you sign here, please?
lines.zh: 可以請您在這裡簽名嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, one moment please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have a great rest of your day.

scene_zh: 晚上做菜臨時缺鹽，向鄰居借一點
image_prompt_en: A chibi person stands at a neighbor's doorway holding an empty small jar while a chibi neighbor hands over a bag of salt, porch light glowing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sorry to bother you, do you have any salt?
lines.zh: 不好意思打擾了，你們家有鹽嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course, let me grab some for you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll return it tomorrow, I promise.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No rush at all, take your time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you so much for helping.

scene_zh: 全家人跟住在南部的阿公阿嬤視訊聊天
image_prompt_en: A chibi family gathers around a tablet propped on the table, waving at chibi grandparents on the screen, a warm living room in the background.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Grandma, can you see us clearly?
lines.zh: 阿嬤，你看得清楚我們嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I can see you all perfectly.
lines.zh: 看得很清楚，你們都好嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We miss you, when are you visiting?
lines.zh: 我們好想你，你什麼時候要來玩？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe next month, if the weather is nice.
lines.zh: 也許下個月吧，天氣好的話。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We can't wait to see you.

scene_zh: 客廳電燈一直閃爍，請電工來檢查
image_prompt_en: A chibi electrician stands on a small ladder examining a flickering ceiling light while a chibi homeowner watches from below holding a flashlight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The light keeps flickering on and off.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let me check the wiring up here.
lines.zh: 我來檢查一下上面的線路。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it something dangerous, do you think?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, it's just a loose connection.
lines.zh: 不會，只是接頭鬆了而已。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for fixing it so fast.

scene_zh: 孩子幫忙擺碗筷準備吃晚餐
image_prompt_en: A chibi kid places plates and chopsticks around a dinner table while a chibi parent carries a steaming pot from the kitchen to the table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you set the table for dinner?
lines.zh: 你可以幫忙擺晚餐的餐具嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, how many people are eating tonight?
lines.zh: 好啊，今晚有幾個人吃飯？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Four of us, plus grandma is joining.
lines.zh: 我們四個，加上阿嬤也會來。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it, I'll set five places then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Dinner should be ready in ten minutes.

scene_zh: 週末全家一起整理堆滿雜物的車庫
image_prompt_en: A chibi dad and chibi kid sort through boxes and old tools in a cluttered garage, separating items into keep and donate piles.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This garage is a total mess.
lines.zh: 這個車庫真的亂七八糟。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's sort things into keep and donate piles.
lines.zh: 我們把東西分成留下跟捐出去兩堆。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What about this old bicycle over here?
lines.zh: 這台舊腳踏車怎麼處理？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We haven't used it in years, let's donate it.
lines.zh: 好幾年都沒騎了，捐掉吧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Agreed, this place will look so much better.

scene_zh: 夫妻晚上討論這個月的家庭開銷
image_prompt_en: A chibi couple sits at a table reviewing bills and a notebook with numbers, a calculator and a jar of coins nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We spent more on groceries this month.
lines.zh: 這個月我們菜錢花比較多。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, prices have gone up a lot lately.
lines.zh: 對啊，最近東西都漲價了。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Maybe we should cook at home more often.
lines.zh: 我們也許該多在家煮飯。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That's a good idea, it will save money.
lines.zh: 這是個好主意，能省不少錢。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's plan next week's meals together.
lines.zh: 我們一起規劃下週的菜單吧。

scene_zh: 爸爸陪孩子一起解決數學作業的難題
image_prompt_en: A chibi kid sits at a desk with a math worksheet while a chibi dad leans over pointing at a problem, a pencil and eraser on the desk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm stuck on this math problem.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's read the question together carefully.
lines.zh: 我們一起仔細再讀一次題目。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I don't understand this part at all.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Try drawing a picture to help you.
lines.zh: 試試看畫個圖來幫忙理解。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, now it makes more sense.

scene_zh: 兩位家長討論本週輪流接送小孩上學
image_prompt_en: Two chibi parents chat beside a car parked outside a school, one holding a phone with a schedule, kids with backpacks nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you drive the kids to school tomorrow?
lines.zh: 你明天能載小孩去上學嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, and I'll pick them up too.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我也會去接他們。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll take Wednesday and Friday then.
lines.zh: 那我負責星期三跟星期五。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sounds fair, let's confirm the pickup time.
lines.zh: 這樣公平，我們確認一下接送時間。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Seven forty-five works well for us.
lines.zh: 七點四十五對我們來說很好。

scene_zh: 家人討論如何正確設定新裝的保全警報系統
image_prompt_en: A chibi family member points at a wall-mounted alarm panel by the front door while another chibi family member checks a phone app showing camera feeds.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do we arm the alarm at night?
lines.zh: 晚上要怎麼啟動保全警報？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just press this button before we go to bed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What if we forget and open a window?
lines.zh: 如果我們忘記還開了窗戶呢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It will send an alert to our phones.
lines.zh: 它會傳警示到我們手機上。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good, that makes me feel safer.
lines.zh: 太好了，這樣我比較安心。

scene_zh: 夫妻對客廳冷氣溫度太冷還太熱有點意見不同
image_prompt_en: A chibi couple stands by a wall thermostat in a living room, one wrapped in a blanket shivering, the other fanning themselves with a magazine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's freezing in here, can we turn it up?
lines.zh: 這裡好冷，可以把溫度調高一點嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: But it's so hot for me right now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How about we meet in the middle?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, let's set it to seventy-two degrees.
lines.zh: 好啊，那就設在七十二度吧。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That sounds much more comfortable.

scene_zh: 媽媽跟孩子一起規劃這週末的生日派對
image_prompt_en: A chibi mom and chibi kid decorate a table with balloons and a small cake, a guest list notebook open beside colorful party hats.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Who should we invite to your party?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I want to invite my whole class.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's a lot of guests to plan for.
lines.zh: 這樣要準備的東西不少呢。

lines.speaker: B

scene_zh: 全家悠閒地一起準備星期天的早餐

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should we make pancakes this morning?
lines.zh: 今天早上我們煮鬆餅好嗎？

lines.zh: 可以，小心那個燙的平底鍋。

lines.zh: 這是我最喜歡的星期天開場方式。

scene_zh: 在電影院售票口買兩張電影票並選座位

lines.zh: 如果可以的話，中間的位子。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, we'll take those.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's grab one before they run out.

lines.speaker: A

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: What time would you like to come in?

lines.zh: 今晚八點左右，唱三小時。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That works, we have a room open.

lines.en: Great, please put it under my name.
lines.zh: 太好了，請用我的名字訂位。

scene_zh: 在登山口向管理員詢問步道難度與路線建議
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a trailhead signpost, one wearing a backpack and pointing at a map while the other gestures toward a mountain path.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Which trail is best for beginners?
lines.zh: 哪一條步道最適合初學者？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The riverside loop is pretty easy.
lines.zh: 沿河的環狀步道比較輕鬆。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long does it usually take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About two hours if you go slowly.
lines.zh: 如果慢慢走大概兩小時。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sounds good, thanks for the tip.
lines.zh: 聽起來不錯，謝謝你的建議。

title_en: Renting a Bike by the River
scene_zh: 在河濱公園租借點租借腳踏車
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a riverside bike rental stand, one handing over an ID card while the other picks out a bicycle from a row of parked bikes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is it to rent a bike for an hour?
lines.zh: 租一台腳踏車一小時多少錢？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's one hundred dollars an hour.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I get one with a basket?
lines.zh: 可以給我一台有籃子的嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, this one has a basket in front.
lines.zh: 當然，這台前面就有籃子。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect, I'll take that one.

scene_zh: 在游泳池入口向救生員詢問使用規則
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a swimming pool entrance, one holding a swim cap while a lifeguard in a whistle points to pool lane markers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do I need a swim cap to enter?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, caps are required for everyone.
lines.zh: 是的，每個人都要戴泳帽。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Which lane is for slower swimmers?
lines.zh: 哪一個水道是給游得比較慢的人？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Lane one is for beginners.
lines.zh: 第一水道是給初學者的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it, thanks for letting me know.

scene_zh: 在籃球場邊詢問能否加入鬥牛比賽
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters on an outdoor basketball court, one holding a basketball and asking to join while the other players wait near the hoop.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Mind if I join the next game?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, we need one more player.
lines.zh: 當然，我們正好缺一個人。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What's the score limit?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: First team to eleven wins.
lines.zh: 先到十一分的隊伍獲勝。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cool, let's get started.

title_en: Signing Up for a Run Club
scene_zh: 在公園向跑步社團成員詢問加入方式
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters in running gear at a park meeting point, one holding a clipboard sign-up sheet while runners stretch nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is this the running club meetup?
lines.zh: 這裡是跑步社團的集合點嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, are you here to join us?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd love to, how do I sign up?
lines.zh: 我很想加入，要怎麼報名？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just write your name on this list.
lines.zh: 在這張清單上寫下你的名字就好。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, see you at the next run.

scene_zh: 在運動中心櫃台預約網球場時段
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a sports center counter, one holding a tennis racket while the other checks a court booking schedule on a tablet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is court two available this afternoon?
lines.zh: 今天下午二號球場有空嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it's free from three to four.
lines.zh: 有的，三點到四點是空的。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll book that slot, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, can I get your name?
lines.zh: 好的，可以給我您的名字嗎？

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's under Chen, thanks.

scene_zh: 和朋友討論週末去溪邊釣魚的計畫
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters near a river holding fishing rods, one showing a tackle box while the other points toward the water.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you want to go fishing this weekend?
lines.zh: 這週末要不要一起去釣魚？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sounds fun, where should we go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: There's a nice spot by the river.
lines.zh: 河邊有一個不錯的地方。

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll bring my own fishing rod.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, let's meet there at eight.
lines.zh: 太好了，我們八點那邊見。

scene_zh: 在桌遊咖啡廳向店員詢問遊戲推薦
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters at a board game cafe table, one browsing a shelf of colorful game boxes while the other sets up a game on the table.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you recommend a game for two players?
lines.zh: 可以推薦一款適合兩人玩的遊戲嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: This strategy game is really popular.
lines.zh: 這款策略遊戲很受歡迎。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long does a round usually take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About thirty minutes per round.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's give it a try.

scene_zh: 兩位朋友討論最近在玩的電動遊戲
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters sitting on a couch holding game controllers, a TV screen glowing in front of them with a game paused.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What have you been playing lately?
lines.zh: 你最近都在玩什麼遊戲？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I just started this new racing game.
lines.zh: 我剛開始玩一款新的賽車遊戲。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it hard to get the hang of?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really, the controls are simple.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Mind if I try a round?

scene_zh: 兩位攝影愛好者一起在公園拍照
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters walking through a park holding cameras, one crouching to photograph a flower while the other points toward a scenic view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This lighting is perfect for photos.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Let's walk toward the bridge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you take a picture of me here?
lines.zh: 可以幫我在這裡拍張照嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, strike a pose.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks, that one looks great.

scene_zh: 朋友們在公園鋪野餐墊準備享用食物
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters sitting on a picnic blanket in a park, spreading out sandwiches and a fruit basket under a tree.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should we set up under this tree?
lines.zh: 我們要不要在這棵樹下鋪墊子？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: That looks like a perfect spot.
lines.zh: 這個位置看起來很完美。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I brought some sandwiches and fruit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I made lemonade for everyone.
lines.zh: 我準備了檸檬水給大家喝。

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: This is going to be a great afternoon.

title_en: Watching a Ball Game at a Bar
scene_zh: 朋友們在運動酒吧一邊喝飲料一邊看球賽
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters sitting at a bar counter with drinks, looking up at a large screen showing a baseball game.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What time does the game start?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It starts in about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can we get a table near the screen?
lines.zh: 我們可以坐在螢幕附近的桌子嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, that one over there is open.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's order some snacks too.

scene_zh: 在滑雪場租借中心租滑雪板與鞋子

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I need to rent skis and boots.
lines.zh: 我需要租滑雪板和雪靴。

lines.en: What size shoe do you wear?

lines.en: I wear a size nine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Here you go, try these on.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: They fit perfectly, thank you.

scene_zh: 初學者在海邊上第一堂衝浪課
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters on a sandy beach with surfboards, one demonstrating how to stand while the other practices on the board.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is this my first time on a board?
lines.zh: 這是我第一次站上衝浪板嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, let's start with balance practice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do I stand up correctly?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼正確地站起來？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Push up with your arms first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, I think I got it.

scene_zh: 朋友們在密室逃脫房間裡合作解謎題

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What does this clue mean?

lines.en: Maybe it's a code for the lock.

lines.en: It worked, the box is open!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: We only have five minutes left.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can I rent an audio guide here?
lines.zh: 我可以在這裡租語音導覽嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, it's available in five languages.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'll take the English version, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Here's your device and headphones.
lines.zh: 這是您的導覽機和耳機。

lines.en: Thanks, where should I start?
lines.zh: 謝謝，我應該從哪裡開始看？

scene_zh: 在獨立書店向店員詢問小說推薦
image_prompt_en: Two chibi characters in a cozy bookstore, one browsing a shelf of novels while the other holds up a book to recommend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you recommend a good mystery novel?
lines.zh: 可以推薦一本好看的推理小說嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: This one just won an award.

lines.en: What's it about?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's about a detective in a small town.
lines.zh: 是講一位小鎮偵探的故事。

lines.en: That sounds interesting, I'll take it.
lines.zh: 聽起來很有趣，我要買這本。

scene_zh: 在湖邊租借划船並詢問安全注意事項

lines.en: Do we need life jackets?

lines.en: Yes, please put these on first.

lines.en: It starts at six this evening.

lines.en: Do I need to bring my own mat?
lines.zh: 我需要自己帶瑜珈墊嗎？

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, we provide mats for everyone.
lines.zh: 不用，我們有提供瑜珈墊。

lines.en: I'll serve first.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not for that one, it's low enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, I'll give it a try.

title_en: Ordering at a Bubble Tea Shop
scene_zh: 和朋友在手搖飲店排隊點珍珠奶茶

lines.en: Do you want extra boba?

lines.en: Yes, and less sugar too.

lines.en: Sounds good, I'll order that.
lines.zh: 聽起來不錯，我去點這個。

scene_zh: 朋友們在河堤旁找位置準備看煙火表演

lines.en: What time do the fireworks start?

lines.en: They should start around nine.
